title: Bangkok to Phuket: Southern Thailand EV Adventure
subtitle: A 4-day family EV road trip through tropical Thailand

route.kidActivities: Hua Hin Beach playground, Vana Nava Water Jungle
Chumphon Aquarium, Thung Wua Laen Beach
Phuket Aquarium, Big Buddha, Kata Beach

bestFor: Families wanting a relaxed south Thailand road trip with easy highway driving
tips: PTT stations along Route 4 have EA Anyonde fast chargers every 30-40km
The Surat Thani MG Charge Makro (150kW) is a critical mid-point stop
Book EV-friendly hotels in advance — Banyan Tree Hua Hin and Rosewood Phuket offer charging
